title: Permission Denied
story: The nightly backup script suddenly refuses to run. Nobody changed the code, but someone touched the file.
goal: Make /opt/backup/run.sh executable (mode 755) and report which command shows its permissions.
hints: The log says Permission denied. Which command shows who may read, write and run a file?
ls -l shows the mode. chmod changes it; 755 means owner rwx, others r-x.
socratic: What does the log complain about?
Which three letters in ls -l matter for running a script?
Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
